name: Crimson Scream
desc: A face consumed by crimson horror — raw terror distilled into digital art.

name: The Last Wanderer
desc: Across a dead world he walks, the last keeper of forgotten lore.

name: The Dissolving Mind
desc: A mind unravelling into the labyrinth — chaos made beautiful.

name: Iron Captive
desc: A winged titan bound in chains, kneeling before the burning citadel.

name: Shadow Covenant
desc: A pact forged between flesh and shadow, sealed in the ruins of the old world.

name: The Dark Forest
desc: In the moonlit void of the cursed wood, something ancient stirs.

name: Fell Dominion
desc: A sorcerer surveys the ruins of civilisation from the edge of oblivion.

name: The Dark Sermon
desc: Between beast and believer — a confrontation beyond the veil of reason.

name: Mystical Madness
desc: A serpent deity coils through the enchanted forest — power dressed in shadow.

name: Void Sovereign
desc: A lone figure stands before the infernal city — master of all that burns.

name: Blood Ritual
desc: Wide-eyed and drenched in red — a witness to something that cannot be unseen.

name: Neon Wraith
desc: Through the rain-slicked streets of a dying city, she carries another world within.

name: Electric Specter
desc: Neon-lit and storm-soaked — a presence that belongs to neither world.

name: Storm Keep
desc: Lightning crowns the cursed castle as purple mist swallows the hillside below.

name: The Oracle's Gaze
desc: Through a portal of twisted roots, a porcelain face watches without blinking.

name: Signal from Beyond
desc: An alien intelligence transmits across the cosmos — the receiver is already listening.

name: Storm Fury
desc: Standing in the eye of the maelstrom — defiant against the consuming void.

name: Ruinborn
desc: She runs through the burning aftermath — blade in hand, world in flames.

name: Obsidian Child
desc: Porcelain black eyes in the shadow of a haunted forest — innocence swallowed whole.

name: The Unchained
desc: Freed from his chains, the giant tears through civilisation with elemental fury.
